newsitem.title: USA: Gateway 2000 cuts price of big screen TV.
newsitem.headline: Gateway 2000 cuts price of big screen TV.

text.p: Gateway 2000 Inc said Wednesday it is cutting prices by up to 13 percent on four models of its Destination Big Screen PC/TV product line.
The Destination product, which can be used to watch movies or TV, play video games or use the Web, will now be priced as low as $2,499.
Gateway, a direct marketer of personal computer products, said the reduced prices reflect the lower cost of components.

Gateway declined to disclose the number of units it has sold since the April 1996 introduction of the Destination product. However, Stacy Hand, marketing manager for Destination, said, "We are very excited about sales so far and even more excited by prospects down the road."
Shares of Gateway were trading up 1-13/16 to 42-3/16.
